articles.title: Trump to host 3rd ‘exclusive’ memecoin event amid corruption claims
articles.snippet: The president is scheduled to appear at his golf club in Washington, DC, at a Nov. 22 dinner for his top 185 memecoin holders, following similar events in May 2025 and April 2026.

articles.title: Reddit Is Killing RSS Feeds and Public API Access to Fight AI Scrapers
articles.snippet: Reddit RSS dies November 13 and outside apps lose their data pipeline by March 2027. Reddit blames scraping bots, though it licenses its own content to AI companies.

articles.title: The 'Largest Pure-Play' XRP Treasury Is About to Go Public
articles.snippet: Shareholders approved Evernorth's merger with Armada Acquisition Corp. II, clearing the way for the Ripple-backed firm to begin trading Oct. 8 with a stash of roughly 473 million XRP.

articles.title: Dogecoin Is Getting Apps as DogeOS Opens Its Public Testnet
articles.snippet: The team behind the MyDoge wallet opened a public test of DogeOS, a layer that lets developers build lending platforms and games on top of the meme coin network.

articles.title: Coinbase-Backed Crypto Group Reveals Midterm Endorsements After Clarity Act Collapse
articles.snippet: The Coinbase-backed group's first Senate endorsements—Republicans Jon Husted and Ashley Hinson and Democrat Chris Pappas—come two weeks after the Clarity Act's collapse, as the industry's fight shifts to the campaign trail.
